tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind every surface (app body, context bar strip).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, top navigation, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header row, filter/search strip, hovered table row, disabled inputs.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected table row (the current dataset/issue), together with a 'Đang chọn' tag.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers: table rows, card outlines, nav bottom edge.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, chips) — 3:1 on `surface` and `canvas`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on `surface`, `canvas`, `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, table cells of lower importance, nav items at rest. On `surface`/`surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions, meta lines (CVAT project #31, timestamps), table headers, placeholder. 4.5:1 on `surface` and `canvas`; avoid on `surface-sunken` for body sizes.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, active nav underline, checked controls. The only 'action' colour — graphite, not a hue.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text/icons on `primary`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: LabelX logo mark only. Never for buttons, links or states.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Text of positive states: CHECKED, RELEASED, Đạt. On `success-soft`.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Text of partial/attention states: PARTIAL, READY · chờ duyệt, coverage below threshold. On `warning-soft` or `surface`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Text of blocking states: BLOCKED, FAILED, critical. On `danger-soft` or `surface`.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger badges and the release-blocked banner.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Text of in-progress/informational states: RUNNING, IN REVIEW. On `info-soft`.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info badges.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Text of inert states: NOT CHECKED, — , draft. On `neutral-soft`.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Background of neutral badges and the version tag.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Background of the annotation canvas in Review Workspace — the only dark surface in the product. Text on it uses `on-stage`.

tokens.name: on-stage
tokens.usage: Text and controls drawn over `stage` (16:1).

tokens.name: overlay-annotation
tokens.usage: Outline of the current annotation drawn on `stage` (solid line).

tokens.name: overlay-candidate
tokens.usage: Outline of a candidate / model proposal drawn on `stage` (dashed line, so it never relies on hue alone).

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen, top-left of content.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Đồng bộ Dataset từ CVAT, bao gồm Project và Version.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Primary cell in a table row, emphasised values.

styles.name: table
styles.usage: Table body cells; numbers use tabular figures.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines under a cell value, footnotes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Table column headers and badge text, uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Mã: Quality Control Run, snapshot, revision, issue.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and buttons; badge horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding; input padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter and gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page header and first section.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small elements only: status badges, version tags. The one slight rounding in the system.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, icon buttons — square by design (0).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, menus, panels, the annotation workspace — large blocks are square (0).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Context chips in the context bar, and round controls (avatar, switch, status dot).

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus and popovers only. Cards and tables use `border`, never a shadow.

tokens.name: topnav-height
tokens.usage: Top navigation bar.

tokens.name: contextbar-height
tokens.usage: Context bar under the nav.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Two-line table row (value + caption).
